result.summary: Full mix test suite run via scripts/test_parallel.sh, branch feature/WF03-ISS0279-20260822. First attempt at N=16 (nproc-derived) crashed every partition before any Result: line (build-dir lock contention + DBConnection.ConnectionError during ecto.migrate) -- this is the documented ISS-0219 pattern verbatim, not a code regression. Re-ran with TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 per that same script comment's verified-clean value. Real output tail: 'partition 1: 434 tests, 1 property, 1 failures, exit 2' / 'partition 2: 559 tests, 2 properties, 3 failures, exit 2' / 'partition 3: 401 tests, 2 properties, 0 failures, exit 0' / 'partition 4: 402 tests, 0 properties, 0 failures, exit 0' / 'combined: 1796 tests, 5 properties, 4 failures (1797/1801 passed)'. All 4 failures diagnosed individually: (1) Letflow.Api.ContextTest 'scoped_repo_opts/1 ignores request-supplied tenant hints (INV-1, AC3)' -- test/letflow/api/context_test.exs:125-126, asserts function_exported?(Context, :scoped_repo_opts, 1); pre-existing, unrelated to this branch (Context module not touched here). (2)-(4) Letflow.TenantSchemaReaperTest, three sub-failures in test/support/tenant_schema_reaper_test.exs (schema_name format guard, ISS-0110 concurrent-invocation liveness guard, orphan reclaim) -- caused by a live 'Postgrex.Error) FATAL 53300 (too_many_connections)' during the run plus the ISS-0110 cross-invocation deferral logic firing because sibling partitions were connected concurrently; matches documented ISS-0194/ISS-0110/ISS-0222 connection-pressure flake patterns, and TenantSchemaReaper is not touched by this branch. This branch's own files (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.audit_issue_closures.ex, test/mix/tasks/letflow.audit_issue_closures_test.exs, docs/agents/protocols/ISSUE_QUEUE.md, docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md) appear in none of the 4 failures or their stack traces -- grep for 'audit_issue_closures'/'AuditIssueClosures' across all partition logs returns zero matches outside the file list itself, i.e. the new test file's cases ran clean and silent (ExUnit --no-color only prints failing tests). Doc-only changes cannot break a test and did not. Verdict: no regression introduced by this branch; all 4 failures are pre-existing/infra flake unrelated to ISS-0279.
